summary: Fortress Credit Realty Income Trust entered a Master Repurchase and Securities Contract with Capital One on September 30, 2026, providing up to $750 million ($400 million initially available, with $350 million conditional on Buyer approval) to finance acquisition/origination of mortgage loans and mezzanine loans through subsidiary FCR CRE CONA Seller LLC. The initial availability period expires September 30, 2027, with three one-year extension options (two at Seller's election). A guaranty, dated September 30, 2026, provides a limited guaranty and financial covenants including minimum net worth, liquidity, and maximum leverage. This is a routine credit facility arrangement, not a special situation.
